messages:
Vikram Rao: Quick ask 1 — partners want a compact "announce playbook" + slotting snapshot for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Can we finalize owners and blockers?
Helena Ortiz: I'll produce the one-slide playbook. Need SKU counts by region and any firmware/microcode holds. @Vendor Rep - N any blockers?
Vendor Rep - N: Small H200 microcode validation on ~3% SKUs. Patch ETA 2026-04-22. We'll publish immutable image tag + SBOM once validated. APAC capacity limited initial week.
Kai Moore: For MI300/Gaudi: early MI300 bins show thermal-limited throughput on long sequences; recommend mi300-quant for launch. Gaudi teams expect limited rack density in some zones. Perf matrices incoming.
Vikram Rao: Proposed public embargo/handshake: 10-day marketing embargo; vendors supply tag+SBOM 72h before canary; platform will run 24h smoke + 48h limited prod (5% traffic). Triggers: 5xx > 0.2% OR p99 > baseline*1.25 OR token-cost delta > 20% -> auto-fallback. Agree?
Helena Ortiz: Agree. Add requirement: immutable image hash in marketplace before canary start and signed SBOM. Legal needs marketing form 5 business days prior.
Vendor Rep - Gaudi: We'll drop perf delta sheet (2k/16k/48k) and image tags by 2026-04-21 EOD.
Kai Moore: SI checklist items: image tag + hash, SBOM, smoke script, device-plugin helm values, perf regression harness, rollback playbook. I'll post the checklist link shortly.
Vendor Rep - N: Smoke curl example we'll share: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"h200-cv","seq_len":512,"requests":100}'
```
Helena Ortiz: Action items: (1) Vendors: publish tags/SBOMs/perf matrices (2) Kai: publish SI checklist & one-pager (3) Helena: create announce playbook slide + reserve marketplace promo slots (4) Vikram: coordinate legal/marketing handshake.
deploy-bot: Canary pipeline queued by @Helena Ortiz — job #7884. Results will post to #eng-oncall.
Vikram Rao: Thanks everyone. Helena drop the slide by EOD tomorrow and ping marketing for calendar alignment. :thumbsup:
